title: DataTransfer type causing runtime errors
summary: The DataTransfer data type improves AL upgrade code performance but has two undocumented runtime failure scenarios that the compiler does not catch: assigning constant values to Code fields and filtering on FlowFields or Media fields. The post documents these issues and provides workarounds for each.
key_points: DataTransfer.AddConstantValue fails when assigning constants directly to Code fields; use a Code variable instead as a workaround
DataTransfer.AddSourceFilter does not support FlowFields, FlowFilters, or Media type fields; fall back to traditional SetRange and ModifyAll methods
These issues may be fixed in future platform builds; the first issue was resolved in platform 27.0.44405 and 26.0.44406
AL compiler does not warn about these problems before runtime execution

quotes.text: The DataTransfer data type is great for improving AL upgrade code performance.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the value of DataTransfer while introducing the undocumented limitations that follow
